Why was Ben Shapiro's security on a call with Charlie Kirk's security during his hospital transport? 

Well, Ben Shapiro, on his own show, says his security was in contact with Charlie's security and getting updates during the hospital transport. 

In light of the week of Charlie Kirk's preliminary hearing. Candace wants to know why and says the timing (right as lawsuits, including her own defamation suit with Charlie's head of security, dig into that car ride) looks like Ben getting ahead of the story. She's also claiming foreign military ties to Ben's security detail.

Not everyone's buying Candace’s boldness this week though. Andrew Kolvet (EP of The Charlie Kirk show) and others say the evidence coming to light will continue to undercut her earlier claims, like the fact that Robinson wasn't the lone shooter, or wasn't even there.

Kolvet's response to Ben's comments specifically? Silence so far. The back-and-forth is heating up as more evidence surfaces, and everyone's watching to see what's real.
